title_sq: Ne Fresk, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Hapesira Te Bollshme !!!
description_sq: Ne Fresk, prane Anna Market, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Hapesira Te Bollshme. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe bruto 96 m2, neto 81.6 m2 dhe ndodhet ne katin e 4-te te nje pallati 6-katesh te mireadministruar me ashensor. Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne korridorin i cili ben shperndarjen ne dhomen e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit me dalje ne ballkon, nje dhome gjumi matrimoniale, nje dhome per femije dhe nje tualet me dritare. Orientimi i apartamentit eshte Jug-Lindje cka i mundeson apatamentit ndricim nayral dhe diell gjate gjithe dites. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode. Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor dhe shitet me cmim 12.900.000 leke.
title_en: In Freske, 2+1 apartment with ample space for sale!!!
description_en: In Fresk, near Anna Market, 2+1 apartment with ample space for sale. The apartment has a gross area of ​​96 m2, net 81.6 m2 and is located on the 4th floor of a well-managed 6-story building with an elevator. The apartment is organized in the corridor which divides the living room together with the kitchen corner with access to the balcony, a matrimonial bedroom, a children's room and a bathroom with a window. The orientation of the apartment is South-East, which allows the apartment natural lighting and sun throughout the day. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life. The property has regular mortgage documentation and is sold at the price of 12,900,000 lek.
